Calls.definition: Product name of the Mattermost voice/video calling feature; stays in English as a product name.

call.definition: A real-time voice (and screen sharing) session held inside a channel or direct message.

start a call.definition: To begin a new call in a channel, making it joinable by channel members.

join a call.definition: To enter an ongoing call in a channel.

leave a call.definition: To exit a call oneself while it continues for other participants.

end a call.definition: To terminate the call for everyone; a host action, distinct from leaving.

host.definition: The participant with control over the call, who can mute others, stop recordings, and end the call.

make host.definition: To transfer the host role to another call participant.

host controls.definition: The set of moderation actions available to the call host, such as muting or removing participants.

participant.definition: A person currently connected to a call.

recording.definition: A saved audio/video capture of a call, posted to the channel when it finishes.

transcription.definition: The automatic text transcript generated from a call recording.

live captions.definition: Real-time subtitles of what participants say, displayed during the call.

raise hand.definition: To signal that you want to speak by showing a hand indicator to other participants.

lower hand.definition: To remove your raised-hand indicator; the host can also lower a participant's hand.

screen share.definition: Showing your screen to other call participants; also called presenting.

mute.definition: To turn off a microphone during a call; in Calls this refers to audio, not channel notifications.

unmute.definition: To turn a call participant's microphone back on.

mute others.definition: A host action that mutes all other participants' microphones at once.

call ringing.definition: The incoming-call ring notification played when someone starts a call in a direct or group message.

pop out.definition: To open the call controls in a separate window instead of the in-channel widget.

speaker view.definition: Call layout that enlarges the active speaker or shared screen.

grid view.definition: Call layout showing all participants in equal-sized tiles.

blur background.definition: A video option that blurs the participant's camera background.

meeting summary.definition: An AI-generated summary created from a call's transcription.

RTCD.definition: Mattermost's standalone real-time communication daemon that offloads call traffic; service name.

TURN.definition: Relay protocol used to route call media through restrictive networks; technical identity.

ICE.definition: Connectivity-establishment protocol used by WebRTC calls; technical identity.

WebRTC.definition: The browser real-time communication technology that Calls is built on; technical identity.
